answer_1.quote: ...Through comprehensive experiments, we demonstrate that ULTRAIF significantly enhances the instruction-following capabilities of LLMs... We assess the generability of ULTRAIF by evaluating it on mathematical, reasoning, coding, and general conversation domains...
answer_1.outputs: synthesized complex instructions, evaluation questions, and model-generated responses

answer_2.quote: ...We evaluate using loose and strict accuracy metrics at prompt and instruction levels... The pass rate decreases with increasing instruction complexity... We report win rates on ArenaHard and accuracy on benchmarks...

answer_3.quote: ...We use the LLM-as-judge paradigm... the quality of generated responses is assessed by evaluation questions... We employ GPT-4-1106-preview as the evaluator...

answer_4.quote: ...We conduct a human evaluation study, where we randomly sample 75 examples from the SFT dataset and assign each to five human annotators. The resulting agreement shows that LLM evaluations achieve an accuracy of approximately 80%...
answer_4.guideline: Human annotators assess whether the response satisfies the provided evaluation question, measuring agreement and accuracy.
